Far predating the iPod, the Sony Walkman was already an essential device for anyone wanting to add a soundtrack to daily life. Now there is an app called Duo-Man that can recreate that feeling for those of us who once owned a Walkman, and it even works with Apple Music……

Before the Walkman came along, if you wanted to listen to music on the go, your choices were actually quite limited. Most cassette players at the time were bulky and not truly portable. Sony took a recorder originally designed for journalists and shrank it down into the smallest cassette player of its era, and it quickly became a classic product of that age.

Developer Vidit Bhargava created this app at a hackathon event—because many people at the event had never actually seen a real Walkman in person, he brought along an actual unit to show them what it was all about.

You open Duo, pick the album you want to "insert into the cassette," then close it, and the music begins to play.

Bhargava said he originally built this app just as a fun demonstration, but he has now decided to officially release it to the market. The best comment in his post on X is this—an image that only a certain age group would understand.

What was the first music player you ever owned? Feel free to share in the comments section.
